candidate: Data Center Nostrum Evergreen (Data Riocaya, SLU), Plataforma Logística del Suroeste Europeo, Badajoz, Spain
coordinate_reference_system: Source parcels in EPSG:25829 (ETRS89 / UTM 29N) as served by the Catastro INSPIRE cadastral-parcel WFS (GetParcel, srsname EPSG::25829; each response declares http://www.opengis.net/def/crs/EPSG/0/25829); the planar area centroid of their union is transformed to EPSG:4326 longitude/latitude with pyproj 3.7.1 always_xy=True.
source_selection: Decreto 151/2025 of 11 November 2025 (DOE no. 221, 17 November 2025), which declared the Data Riocaya, SLU data-centre project a Proyecto Empresarial de Interés Autonómico, places the data centre on plots L.I-12, L.I-13, C.E.S-2, C.E.S-4 and C.E.S-4A of the Plataforma Logística del Suroeste Europeo in Badajoz, 222,735 m2 in total. Catastro's address register (Consulta_DNPRC) names exactly one urban parcel for each of these plot labels on 'PL PLATAFORMA LOGISTICA'; each was retrieved individually from the Catastro INSPIRE WFS (GetParcel). Their declared areas sum to 222,734 m2, 1 m2 short of the decree's total, and their union is one contiguous polygon.

reverse_lookup: Catastro Consulta_RCCOOR at the WGS84 centroid returns parcel 3485901PD7038E (PL PLATAFORMA LOGISTICA, Badajoz), plot L.I-13, one of the five decree plots.
precision: Area centroid of the five Plataforma Logística del Suroeste Europeo plots (L.I-12, L.I-13, C.E.S-2, C.E.S-4, C.E.S-4A; 22.27 ha) that Decreto 151/2025 names as the Data Center Nostrum Evergreen site. It locates the declared data-centre land, not a building footprint, the SE DC Badajoz 220/20 kV substation, the SET Enlace 400/220 kV substation near REE Riocaya, an entrance or a surveyed boundary.
uncertainty_reason: Catastro publishes no positional accuracy for these boundaries. The point is a derived interior anchor of a 22.3 ha declared site whose farthest vertex is about 414 m away; no building layout is published.
not_located: Data-centre buildings, the adjacent SE DC Badajoz 220/20 kV substation, the SET Enlace 400/220 kV substation and its 292 m 400 kV line from REE Riocaya, and the two 220 kV underground supply lines (about 3.3 km each).
computation: python3 (uv run --no-project --with pyproj==3.7.1 --with shapely==2.1.1 python -I): parse each GetParcel exterior ring, shapely unary_union, centroid, pyproj EPSG:25829 to EPSG:4326 always_xy=True; rounded to 7 decimals.
